subject: Next steps: AcmeCorp private VPC discovery / networking & residency
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmecorp.com>, Jordan Taylor <jtaylor@acmecorp.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps - AcmeCorp private VPC discovery

Hi Sanjay / Jordan,

Thanks for the time today - appreciate the clear overview of the platform goals and constraints. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Goal: Run a production-grade LLM inference stack inside AcmeCorp's AWS account (us-east-1) with strict data residency and no egress of PHI.
- Pain points: current vendor latency spikes, runaway costs from multi-tenant shared endpoints, and compliance concerns (PHI, HIPAA, SOC2).
- Driver: upcoming pilot with their clinical-assist workflow next quarter - needs predictable latency and an auditable deployment.

Technical constraints you flagged
- Must deploy in AcmeCorp VPC (customer-managed).
- No internet egress for inference nodes (air-gapped or tightly controlled egress through approved endpoints).
- KMS integration for key management / encryption at rest.
- Audit logs retained for 12+ months and accessible for audits.

Proposed Redwood approach
- Private deployment (customer VPC) or on-prem package depending on your security team's preference.
- Option A: Private VPC deployment - Redwood control plane manages coordination, inference runtime runs in dedicated subnets within your account; no public IPs on inference nodes; NAT/Egress only via approved bastion/proxy (customer controls).
- Option B: On-prem/air-gapped - full offline package; longer lead time, but supports no-egress requirements.

Immediate next steps
1) I will share our architecture overview + SOC2 summary (attached).
2) Technical deep-dive with your cloud/security team - can we target Thu 5/20 11am ET?
3) If procurement is needed, please share procurement contact so we can surface an initial SOW.

Questions for you (quick)
- Can you confirm whether the workload will be strictly PHI or mixed (PHI + non-PHI)?
- Any existing KMS/HSM preferences?
- Expected POC duration & target go-live window?

Attaching: redwood-private-vpc-arch.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks - I'll coordinate the deep dive once I have the security contact.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps - AcmeCorp private VPC discovery

Camila - thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Data residency: must remain in AWS us-east-1.
- Egress: inference nodes cannot initiate outbound connections to the public internet. Any outbound must be tightly controlled and go through our approved proxy (we can provide the proxy IPs / FQDNs).
- Workload: mostly PHI for the pilot (clinical notes), but we may mix in synthetic non-PHI for load testing.
- Compliance: SOC2 + HIPAA controls required; we also have an internal checklist (will share during deep dive).

Can you confirm if Redwood can support a private VPC deployment where inference workers have no public IPs and all egress is blocked except via our proxy? Also need an estimate for POC node sizing and an expected timeline - we are hoping for a 6-8 week POC.

Sanjay Patel
Director, AI Platform
AcmeCorp

Camila - doable. Notes below for the deep-dive and POC plan: 

High-level feasibility
- Private VPC deployment (customer-managed) is supported. We can run the inference runtime in dedicated subnets with no public IPs. Workers will pull model shards and KV cache from a private S3 endpoint or pre-provisioned EBS volumes to avoid public egress.
- Egress control: we can restrict all outbound to the VPC's NAT/proxy; we will rely on customer-provided proxy IPs/FQDNs for any required outbound (metrics/updates) or use a push model for telemetry to an internal endpoint.
- KMS: we support AWS KMS for envelope keys and can integrate with customer-managed keys; for HSM-level requests, we'd need a separate enterprise path.

POC sizing (rough)
- Suggested starter: 4 x A10G-equivalent workers (NVIDIA A10G or equivalent) for 8-12 qps steady state depending on model size (we should confirm model choice).
- Storage: shared EBS or EFS for model artifacts + local NVMe for KV cache per node.

Compliance & audit
- We will provide SOC2 summary and audit log export. For HIPAA / PHI coverage we recommend minimal external telemetry and encrypted audit exports to your S3.

Next steps for the technical deep-dive
1) Schedule 60m deep-dive with your cloud/security team (we're available Thu 5/20 11am ET or Fri 5/21 2pm ET).
2) Customer provides proxy IPs/FQDNs and KMS key ARNs prior to the call.
3) We'll produce an initial SOW and target POC plan (timeline: 6-8 weeks) and sizing.

Attached: redwood-private-vpc-arch.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
